result.summary: A residential street intersection with sidewalks on both sides but lacking formal pedestrian crossing infrastructure. The presence of dense foliage on one corner creates potential sight line obstructions between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of marked crosswalks at the intersection reduces driver awareness of pedestrians.

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Dense tree foliage on the right corner may block visibility between pedestrians and approaching vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install zebra-striped crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Intersection Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs or yield signs to manage traffic flow and improve safety at the crossing.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Trim trees and bushes near the intersection to improve sight lines for all road users.

result.summary: A residential street with two travel lanes and on-street parking. While sidewalks are present, there is a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings or traffic control devices at the visible intersection.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross unmarked pavement.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along the curb line block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The image depicts a one-way street in a mixed-use residential and commercial area with basic pedestrian infrastructure. While sidewalks and a marked crosswalk are present, the crossing lacks high-visibility markings, curb ramps, and clear sightlines due to parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on the right side of the image obstruct the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, adjacent to the crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of ADA Accessibility
hazards.description: No visible curb ramps are present at the crosswalk, creating a barrier for individuals with mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground at the edges of the crosswalk

hazards.name: Low-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The transverse line markings are thin and may not be easily noticed by approaching drivers compared to high-visibility patterns.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20-30 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they cross.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Replace the existing transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to increase the visibility of the crossing.

result.summary: The image shows a two-lane urban street with sidewalks on both sides but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossing infrastructure at the visible intersection. While the environment is mixed-use with commercial and residential buildings, the roadway design prioritizes vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks at the intersection, forcing pedestrians to cross an uncontrolled roadway without designated space.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are visible for the main thoroughfare, which may encourage higher vehicle speeds through the pedestrian-adjacent area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks across all legs of the intersection to define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Yield to Pedestrian' signs to alert drivers of the potential for people crossing the street.
